V55_candidate_clause_ledger.statement: The displayed R1 texture omits h A H2 and L h H2 even though every additive ordinary/R selector preserving the source and filter terms also preserves both fillers.
A complete explicit sparse chiral superpotential exists, but its zero coefficients are not protected and therefore do not define the generic EFT.
The exact sparse 280-coordinate Hessian has four weak modes; adding either forced filler raises the rank by four and leaves no weak-Higgs zero mode.
No physical GS modulus/vector sector, full D-flat solution, soft spectrum, global minimum, or tunnelling analysis is present.
No one-action threshold calculation or frozen low-energy Wilson array has been derived.
The 133-singlet universal-family/RHN repair, the 128-singlet family-only repair, and the five-singlet differentiated-family repair belong to different ledgers and cannot be merged.
No current joint flavour, proton, collider, precision, or cosmological likelihood and withheld prediction exists.

anomaly_branch_ledger.fatal_other_issue: forced Higgs filler and unprotected flavour

anomaly_branch_ledger.cross_action_warning: This 128-field arithmetic ledger omits the three N_i charges and cannot replace the 133-field repair in A1.

final_decision.honest_outcome: V55 completes the bounded R1 kill test. It preserves an exact conditional matter Hessian and finds useful tensor, anomaly, and proton results, but proves that the fixed R1 topology cannot naturally retain the MSSM Higgs pair. R1 is rejected and no complete theory exists.
final_decision.next_redesign_trigger: Start V56 only from a changed source/filter topology; parameter changes or additional additive Abelian selectors cannot rescue R1.

gate_ledger.decision: The frozen historical ordinary-Spin quotient/anomaly lemma is retained only in its old namespace; no physical GS/global quotient exists for R1.
The sparse local Hessian is exact, but the symmetry-complete R1 action has the wrong kernel and lacks the GS/global vacuum sector.
FAILED for R1: forced renormalizable h A H2 and L h H2 terms generically lift all four weak-Higgs zero modes.
No dark-sector or cosmological action and likelihood exists.
The matter-extended one-loop Spin(10) coefficient is recorded, but complete thresholds and two-loop running are absent.
A genuine mixed-family degree-nine proton class exists; it can be numerically suppressed, but its matched Wilson coefficient and lifetime are unknown.
Universal charges do not protect flavour textures; differentiated bounded survivors have no compatible completed GS/matter action or current global fit.

hard_next_architecture_obligations.requirement: Break at least one exact equality behind q(A)=q(B)=q(L), for example by changing the MA^2/MAB source pair or the barC A C/L barC C pair. Merely removing L is insufficient because h A H2 remains forced.
Supply an exact non-Abelian, locality, mediator, or representation-level selection rule that allows the desired filter chain while forbidding every rank-lifting Higgs filler.

For the changed action solve F and D and recompute the complete Hessian and gauge-orbit quotient; the kernel must be exactly 34 gauge, 45 light matter, and four weak-Higgs directions before soft breaking.
Embed realistic Yukawa/RHN textures, the physical GS modulus/vector and a complete tensor/operator census in that same action.
Derive thresholds and Wilson tensors, perform current flavour/proton likelihoods, and add SUSY breaking, EWSB, global-vacuum and cosmological tests before any gate promotion.
